text:
Situation: Milrinone lactate 1 mg/mL, 10 mL vials (NDC 71288020011, labeled by Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc.) are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 158 vials (26.3 days) and Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials (8 days). Corvale East holds a 50 mL presentation (75 vials, 14.8 days) not interchangeable with the 10 mL vial.

Why (FDA record): The NDC maps to Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) in China. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications on 2015-05-12, 2018-04-03, and 2023-11-10. No FDA regulatory action such as an import alert or warning letter is documented for this plant in the provided records.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General but low at Corvale Lakeside. No national shortage exists per FDA. Internal redistribution can resolve the imbalance without new purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 vials of 1 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval (transfer request).
2. If transfer is not feasible, purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer approval.
3. If needed, purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — needs buyer approval.
4. If needed, purchase from Hospira, Inc. — needs buyer approval.
5. If needed, purchase from Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchasing the 50 mL presentation from Corvale East for 10 mL vial needs; delaying action at Corvale Lakeside.
